info.name: EdOrbit - Complete School Management API Collection (All Portals)
info.description:
# EdOrbit School Management System - Master API Collection

This collection contains all APIs organized in a structured, hierarchical format by portal role:

1. **🎓 Student Portal** (20 Modules: Auth, Dashboard, Academic, Fees, Attendance, Exams, Homework, Leaves, Library, Live Classes, Stationary, Study Materials, Tickets, Transport, Chat, Noticeboard, Events, Calendar, Certificates)
2. **👨‍🏫 Teacher & Staff Portal** (24 Modules: Auth, Dashboard, School, Staff, Academics, Students, Accounting, Attendance, Exams, Homework, Leaves, Transport, Library, Chat, Communications)
3. **🏛️ Admin & School Management Portal** (Admin Auth, 47-Permissions Map Dashboard, Class Groups CRUD, Classes & Sections CRUD, School Settings, Logo Insert, Student Admin)
4. **👪 Parent Portal** (Parent Login, Children List, Switch Active Child)

### Authentication Setup:
- All protected endpoints use JWT Bearer Token (`{{B_TOKEN}}` or `{{TOKEN}}`).
- Running **Student - Login** or **Staff - Login** automatically captures the JWT token and populates collection variables.
